title: 2120 Prairie is built
items: 2120 Prairie, on the west side between 21st and 22nd Streets, now stands as a full house in place of its draft. Its plan comes from the 1911 map: a two-storey brick house with an open porch before its door, a two-storey bay clad in sheet iron on its north side, a one-storey brick bay on its south side and a one-storey brick range behind. No picture of it is known, so the red brick front, hooded windows, bracketed cornice, tin roof and the porch on its two columns are a careful best guess, and the house's card says so.
